name: bili-scroll
iconSvg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><rect x="2" y="7" width="20" height="15" rx="3"/><polyline points="17 2 12 7 7 2"/><line x1="8" y1="12" x2="8" y2="12.01"/><line x1="16" y1="12" x2="16" y2="12.01"/></svg>
description: 每天替你刷一轮 B 站：通读原文字幕深度排雷、三档位精选、默认私信投递、支持私信双向对话与分享看片、视频卡片墙与自动收藏。
descriptionEn: Autonomous Bilibili duty agent: reads raw subtitles to filter fluff, delivers curated video digests directly to private DMs, supports bidirectional DM chat, video card wall, and auto-favorite.

settings.label: 定量刷：每天最多挑几条
settings.hint: 每天挑出值得精读的视频数量上限，挑够后当日自动停刷
settings.hintEn: Maximum number of high-quality videos to curate per day

settings.label: 峰谷自动刷（总开关）
settings.hintEn: Enable automated curation rounds during off-peak hours

settings.label: 午间巡检窗口 (12:00–14:00)
settings.hint: 中午时段自动执行一轮巡检
settings.hintEn: Automatically run one curation round at noon

settings.label: 夜间/早间巡检窗口 (00:30–08:30)
settings.hint: 夜间至清晨时段自动执行一轮巡检
settings.hintEn: Automatically run one curation round at night/early morning

settings.label: 投递方式（2.0 默认私信）
settings.hint: only=只私信（完全不公开发评论，不打扰别人）；off=只发公开评论；both=公评与私信兼有
settings.hintEn: only: send DM only (silent & private); off: public comment only; both: both comment and DM

settings.label: 私信发给谁（UID）
settings.hint: 接收速报私信的 B站 用户 UID（可留空，将自动根据下方昵称查询）
settings.hintEn: Target Bilibili user UID; leave empty to resolve from username automatically

settings.label: 要 @ 谁 / 私信接收人昵称
settings.hint: 你的 B站 昵称。私信模式留空 UID 时会按此昵称自动查询 UID；开启公评时会在评论中 @ 该昵称
settings.hintEn: Bilibili username used for @ mention and resolving UID

settings.label: 私信双向对话（看片与回信）
settings.hint: 默认开启。纯代码轮询主人发来的私信，主人发视频链接时自动读字幕后回信，零成本不花多余 token
settings.hintEn: Watch master's DMs and reply; analyzes shared videos via subtitles

settings.label: 私信监听轮询间隔（分钟）
settings.hint: 私信轮询频率，默认每 1 分钟检测一次主人未读私信
settings.hintEn: Frequency to poll for new DMs from the owner

settings.label: 私信回复每日上限（条）
settings.hint: 防止私信频繁刷屏或超支，0 为不限
settings.hintEn: Max auto-replies sent via DM per day (0 for unlimited)

settings.label: 指定研读模型 (provider/model)
settings.hint: 留空跟随当前对话模型；支持填入如 deepseek/deepseek-chat, openai/gpt-4o 等
settings.hintEn: Specific model override (e.g. deepseek/deepseek-chat); leave empty to follow active conversation

settings.label: 思考强度 (Reasoning Effort)
settings.hint: 控制 AI 研读字幕排雷时的思考深度：off=关闭思考，low=轻度快速，medium=中等深度，high=深度推演
settings.hintEn: Thinking depth when analyzing video subtitles: off, low, medium, or high

settings.label: 指定工作区目录 (Workspace)
settings.hint: 指定工作区绝对路径（如 Obsidian 库）。挑中的视频笔记会自动同步投递到该目录的 bili-notes/ 下
settings.hintEn: Custom directory path (e.g. Obsidian vault); curated notes will be mirrored to <workspace>/bili-notes/

settings.label: 它按什么说话（人设提示词）
settings.hint: 留空按中性说话；支持一键从当前工作区导入 AGENTS.md
settings.hintEn: Custom persona prompt; leave empty for neutral tone or import from workspace AGENTS.md

settings.label: 关注关键词列表
settings.default: DeepSeek,大模型,AI智能体,开源项目
settings.hint: 刷视频时重点检索的主题或关键词，逗号分隔或每行一个
settings.hintEn: Comma or newline separated keywords to prioritize

settings.label: 排除/黑名单关键词
settings.hint: 命中这些词的视频将被直接跳过不予精选
settings.hintEn: Excluded keywords to filter out

settings.label: 自动收藏到（收藏夹 fid）
settings.hint: 0 为不收藏；大于 0 时每轮挑中的视频自动存入该收藏夹（可在设置页下拉选择）
settings.hintEn: Target favorite folder ID (0 to disable)

settings.label: 日报写多细
settings.hint: full=完整详尽；brief=每条一两行；off=不写报告（只私信/评论）
settings.hintEn: full: complete digest; brief: one-liners; off: do not write markdown report

settings.label: 允许自动评论并 @ 用户（安全闸）
settings.hint: 默认关闭。开启且投递方式非 only 时，每轮向特别推荐的视频公开发布评论并 @ 昵称
settings.hintEn: Disabled by default. Post public comments when enabled

settings.label: 每轮最多发几条公开评论
settings.hint: 每轮最多发几条公开评论，0 为不发
settings.hintEn: Maximum comments posted per round

settings.label: 回复评论（楼中楼互动）
settings.hint: 默认关闭。开启后仅回复自己评论下方的楼中楼提问与轻互动
settings.hintEn: Reply to sub-replies under our comments

settings.label: 每轮最多回几条评论
settings.hint: 每轮最多回复楼中楼的条数
settings.hintEn: Max replies to sub-comments per round

settings.label: 本地 Whisper 转写（无字幕备选）
settings.hint: 对无字幕视频使用本地 Whisper 提取音频并转写；需在高级页安装转写依赖
settings.hintEn: Use local Whisper to transcribe videos without subtitles

settings.label: Whisper 模型规格
settings.hint: Whisper 模型尺寸：tiny(~75MB), base(~145MB), small(~538MB), medium(~1.5GB)
settings.hintEn: Whisper model size: tiny, base, small, medium

settings.label: Python 解释器路径
settings.hint: Python 执行路径，点击「装主依赖」后会自动指向插件独立环境 .venv
settings.hintEn: Path to Python interpreter, auto-configured after installing dependencies
